'''Randa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who held the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. When a [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] army was massing in the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]] of [[Voss]], he sent a Republic individual to discover what the Gormak were up to.
